desc: The LBE Unlimited CSFLG-RFL Chamber Safety Flag 6 Pack is a set of essential safety devices designed to ensure safe handling and storage of firearms. Each pack includes six chamber safety flags, which are bright red in color, easily visible, and universally recognized as a sign that a firearm is unloaded. The chamber safety flags are made by LBE Unlimited, a reputable manufacturer known for producing high-quality firearm accessories. The flags are constructed with durable materials to withstand regular use and provide reliable safety.
